strings.170:
Enables Open World PvP and grants 10% increased experience for killing Creatures or Players in the Open World.

Enables new crafting materials to drop from resource nodes and creatures in end-game zones.

Can only be cast while in a rested area!

Any death while in the open world with High-Risk Mode active will cause you to drop equipped gear, or Fel Com gold if your gear is insured, and items from your bag.

Enables High-Risk Open World PvP and grants 15% increased experience for killing Creatures or Players in the Open World. You cannot use flying mounts in High-Risk.

Allows you to loot new crafting materials, Bloodforged PvP gear, and Marks of War from the open world, and allows you to interact with Hidden Caches and Beast Nests.

Can only be cast while in a rested area!

PvE Mode disables open world PvP, making you unable to attack or be attacked by other players. 

You cannot heal or buff players in War Mode or High-Risk while in the open world.
